;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Six Israeli nationals are arrested in relation to the [[Kidnapping and murder of Mohammed Abu Khdeir|murder of Muhammad Abu Khdeir]] as [[Palestinians]] continue to riot and clash with police in East Jerusalem and [[Nazareth]]. **In response to over 25 rockets  fired from [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] into [[Israel]] on Sunday, the [[Israeli Air Force|IAF]] carries out airstrikes killing six [[Hamas]] militants. Over 150 rockets and mortars have been fired into Israeli civilian areas over the past three weeks. [http://www.jpost.com/Defense/IAF-strikes-Gaza-in-response-to-continuous-rocket-fire-361586 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
